# yb

> Streamlining media publishing: prepare, upload, and edit videos (YouTube) and podcasts


## Pages

- [yb](index.html.md): Streamline media publishing: **prepare a piece of media once, publish it
- [API reference](api.html.md): | [`yb`](_autosummary/yb.html.md#module-yb)   | yb — streamline media publishing: prepare once, publ...
- [yb](_autosummary/yb.html.md): yb — streamline media publishing: prepare once, publish to YouTube or podcast.
- [yb.audio_convert](_autosummary/yb.audio_convert.html.md): Convert audio files between formats with ffmpeg.
- [yb.config](_autosummary/yb.config.html.md): User configuration for `yb` publishing defaults.
- [yb.content](_autosummary/yb.content.html.md): Target-agnostic publication content: prepare it once, publish anywhere.
- [yb.download](_autosummary/yb.download.html.md): Media download (yt-dlp) — fetch videos, audio, and their metadata.
- [yb.download.youtube](_autosummary/yb.download.youtube.html.md): Download YouTube videos (and their metadata) via yt-dlp.
- [yb.podcast](_autosummary/yb.podcast.html.md): Podcast publishing: show notes, chapters, cover video, and RSS.
- [yb.podcast.chapters](_autosummary/yb.podcast.chapters.html.md): Podcast chapter markers: Podlove Simple Chapters (PSC) + MP3 ID3 chapters.
- [yb.podcast.cover](_autosummary/yb.podcast.cover.html.md): Cover-over-audio video: turn a podcast audio file into a simple video.
- [yb.podcast.feed](_autosummary/yb.podcast.feed.html.md): Podcast RSS feed generation (iTunes-compatible) via feedgen.
- [yb.podcast.publish](_autosummary/yb.podcast.publish.html.md): Assemble a publishable podcast episode from a media file.
- [yb.podcast.shownotes](_autosummary/yb.podcast.shownotes.html.md): Podcast show notes — the human-readable episode description block.
- [yb.youtube](_autosummary/yb.youtube.html.md): YouTube publishing via the YouTube Data API v3.
- [yb.youtube.api](_autosummary/yb.youtube.api.html.md): YouTube video operations: get, upload, update metadata, thumbnail, chapters.
- [yb.youtube.auth](_autosummary/yb.youtube.auth.html.md): OAuth 2.0 plumbing for the YouTube Data API v3.
- [yb.youtube.captions](_autosummary/yb.youtube.captions.html.md): Caption (subtitle) tracks on YouTube videos: list, insert, update, upsert.
- [yb.youtube.metadata](_autosummary/yb.youtube.metadata.html.md): YouTube video metadata ↔ API snippet mapping.
- [yb.youtube.playlists](_autosummary/yb.youtube.playlists.html.md): YouTube playlist operations: find/create a playlist and add videos to it.
- [yb.youtube.publish](_autosummary/yb.youtube.publish.html.md): High-level YouTube publishing: prepare → upload → captions → thumbnail.
- [yb.youtube.search](_autosummary/yb.youtube.search.html.md): Search YouTube for videos, with engagement numbers to rank them by.
- [yb.youtube.stats](_autosummary/yb.youtube.stats.html.md): Read live video metadata & engagement numbers from the YouTube Data API v3.
